newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle market weak - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle market weak - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers wee $1.00 per cwt lower, compared last test on Thursday, USDA said. Trade was slow and demand light to moderate. Seller interest light to moderate. Offerings light.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1275 lbs 64.00-65.00.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1075-1200 lbs 64.00-65.50.
On a carcass basis (weight only) compared Tuesday's close, slaughter steers and heifers were weak in a light test.

Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1250 lbs few 104.00. Holstein - (weight only) Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs 2 lds 97.00 Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1100-1150 lbs few 104.00. Confirmed - 1,200 Week Ago - 1,600 Year Ago - 1,700
